description: The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing three connected displays (1, 2|3) with a dropdown menu open for "Multiple displays" revealing options to duplicate, extend, or show only on specific monitors.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing three detected monitors (1, 2|3) with a dropdown menu expanded offering options to duplicate or extend the desktop across displays 2 and 3.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing a multi-monitor configuration with three displays (1, 2|3), where the user has clicked the dropdown menu revealing options to duplicate, extend, or show only on specific displays.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor configuration with three displays (1, 2, and 3), and the user has opened a dropdown menu to select display mode options like "Duplicate desktop" or "Extend desktop."

Windows 11 Settings app showing the Display settings page with a dropdown menu open for "Multiple displays" options, revealing choices like "Duplicate desktop on 2 and 3", "Extend desktop on 2 and 3", and "Show only on" options for a three-monitor setup.
